title: CTAB Protocol for Isolation of Symbiodinium DNA from Anemones
author: Pringle Lab
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kzqcx5w

steps.title: Homogenize tissue in SDS
steps.instruction: Homogenize each anemone in 500 µl 0.01 % SDS using a rotor‑stator in a screw‑cap or safe‑lock 1.5–2 ml microcentrifuge tube, then shear the homogenate 5 times through a 25‑gauge needle.

steps.title: Pellet algae and wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10,000 ×g for 5–10 min, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 500 µl 0.01 % SDS, repeat centrifugation and supernatant removal.

steps.title: CTAB lysis with beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 600 µl 2× CTAB buffer (contains 2‑mercaptoethanol), add ~200 µl 0.5 mm glass beads, vortex 1–5 min at ≥2000 rpm until no clumps are visible, add 3.6 µl Proteinase K (20 mg/ml) and invert several times, then incubate at 65 °C for 30–60 min, inverting occasionally.

steps.title: First phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 600 µl phenol:chloroform:isoamyl (25:24:1, TE‑buffered pH ≥ 7) and vortex a few seconds to form a milky emulsion; centrifuge 10 min at 14,000 ×g, transfer ~550 µl aqueous upper phase to a new tube; add 500 µl chloroform:isoamyl (24:1), vortex briefly, centrifuge 10 min at 14,000 ×g, transfer ~450 µl aqueous upper phase to a new tube without disturbing the interphase.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml 100 % ethanol (molecular‑biology grade) and mix well; incubate ≥30 min at room temperature; centrifuge ≥30 min at 14,000 ×g at RT with tubes oriented the same way; decant supernatant carefully; add 500 µl 70 % ethanol (do not mix) and centrifuge 5 min at 14,000 ×g; remove supernatant with a pipette without disturbing the pellet; air‑dry 10 min or until ethanol is invisible; resuspend pellet in 30 µl ddH₂O or 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.5; store at –20 °C or use immediately.

steps.title: RNase A treatment
steps.instruction: Add 8 µl RNase A (10 mg/ml stock) to the sample, mix, and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min (up to 1 h for large amounts of material).

steps.title: Second phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 600 µl phenol:chloroform:isoamyl (25:24:1, TE‑buffered pH ≥ 7), vortex several seconds, centrifuge 10 min at 14,000 ×g, and transfer ~500 µl aqueous upper phase to a new tube.
